title: Inverse representation transport of a line power
statement: For every n∈ℕ, σ∈SL₂(ℤ), and τ∈ℍ, let ρ=binaryFormRepSL ℂ n and L(z)=linePow n (z:ℂ). Then ρ(σ⁻¹)(L(στ))=(jFactor(σ,τ)^n)⁻¹ • L(τ), as an equality in BinaryForm ℂ n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), (HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n) σ⁻¹ (HeckeEis.linePow n ((σ • τ : UpperHalfPlane) : ℂ)) = ((HeckeEis.jFactor σ τ) ^ n)⁻¹ • HeckeEis.linePow n (τ : ℂ)
